subject: Re: VectorHealth — Model shortlist & token profile (handoff)
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@vectorhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marc Jacobs <marc.jacobs@vectorhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Model shortlist & token profile for onboarding

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at VectorHealth is excited to move into implementation. Before our internal kickoff, Legal and Engineering asked for a concise model shortlist and an initial token usage profile so they can size infra and procurement. Specifically they want:

- Recommended model candidates (trade-offs: latency vs cost vs context length)
- Suggested max context lengths we should plan for (chat & extracted clinical context)
- Weekly/monthly token volume estimate for our first 90 days based on a projected 15k monthly active users and the query profile below

I've attached a small sample of query logs and a short note on expected concurrency. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call if it's easier.

Thanks,
Alyssa Turner
Product Lead, Conversational UX
VectorHealth

[Attachment: vectorhealth_query_samples.csv (CSV, 34KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@vectorhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marc Jacobs <marc.jacobs@vectorhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model shortlist & token profile for onboarding

Hi Alyssa — great to hear. Thanks for the sample queries, that helps a lot.

I've prepared a short preliminary token profile and an initial model shortlist based on the patterns in the CSV. Key assumptions up front:
- Average user session: 3.8 queries
- Average prompt length (tokens): 120
- Average completion target (tokens): 220 for multi-turn summaries; 80 for single-shot answers
- Peak concurrency estimate (first 90 days): ~120 concurrent requests

Attached: token_profile_v1.xlsx (breakdowns by query type) and a 1-page summary of candidate models. High-level recs in short:
- Candidate A (open-8B-quant): low cost, good for short Q/A and embeddings, <2s p95 on our dedicated pools
- Candidate B (opt-13B-ll): mid cost, better coherence on long summaries, supports 16k context if needed
- Candidate C (redwood-chat-70B-fp16): higher cost, best for clinical summary/regulatory outputs where quality matters

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick sync Tuesday to confirm context length targets (15–30 min)
2) CS handoff doc and access to a small test pool (we'll pre-configure 2 instance types)
3) Finalize model pin for MVP (we can set up canary routing)

Would Tuesday 2/16 at 11:00 PT work for you and Marc?

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Implementation Lead — Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: token_profile_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 27KB), model_shortlist_summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Quick commercial / procurement inputs from my side:

- If VectorHealth expects 15k MAU and the token estimates in Marcus's spreadsheet hold, we should consider a Dedicated pool with burst capacity. That keeps unit cost predictable and avoids throttling.
- I'll start a draft SOW with two options: (a) conservative (opt-13B primary, open-8B fallback) and (b) quality-first (redwood-chat-70B primary).
- Need confirmation from VectorHealth on data retention preferences and SOC 2 evidence for the Legal team. Monica — can you share the standard SOC 2 package URL in the handoff?

Happy to join the kickoff call. Marcus: please confirm the estimated monthly token burn from the spreadsheet so I can put numbers into the proposal.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model shortlist & token profile for onboarding

Thanks — answers inline below.

On average:
- Expected MAU ramp: 3k Month 1, 8k Month 2, 15k Month 3 (steady state assumption)
- Concurrency: peak ~150 during weekday mornings; baseline 40–50
- Desired max context: 8k for chat cases, 16k for the clinical note summarization use case (we may only route ~10% of requests there)
- Data retention: 90 days for logs; patient data is tokenized/PII-stripped before sending — Legal should have the anonymization note in our security questionnaire.

We prefer the quality-first option for any output that goes into clinical records (so Candidate C for summaries) and cost-sensitive models for interactive triage (Candidate A or B).

I'll plan to join Tuesday 2/16 11:00 PT. Looking forward to the handoff doc and the SOW draft.

—Alyssa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@vectorhealth.com>, Marc Jacobs <marc.jacobs@vectorhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: VectorHealth — Implementation handoff: model pin recommendations & sizing

Team — moving this into implementation. Summary and explicit asks below.

Summary points (based on Alyssa's sample and follow-ups):
- Traffic profile (first 90 days ramp): Month1=3k MAU, Month2=8k, Month3=15k (see spreadsheet). Expect weekly active sessions ~25% of MAU, avg queries/session 3.8.
- Token assumptions (conservative): avg prompt 120 tokens, avg completion 150 tokens (mix of short answers + occasional 400–600 token summaries).
- Estimated token burn (Month3 steady state): ~1.8M requests/month => ~486M tokens/month (combined prompt+completion) — see attached token_profile_v1.xlsx for breakdowns by query type.
- Model recommendations (shortlist + pin recs):
  * interactive triage: open-8B-quant (cost-optimized) — route ~70% traffic
  * clinical summarization: redwood-chat-70B-fp16 (quality) — route ~10% (canary first 5% then increase)
  * fallback for mid-traffic: opt-13B-ll (balance) — route ~20%

Action items:
- Monica: share SOC 2 package link + onboarding checklist with VectorHealth (Legal asked).
- Ben: start SOW draft using the Month3 burn as the baseline; include Dedicated pool option and burst credits. Deal: VH-2397.
- Alyssa/VectorHealth: confirm whether the 16k context summarization will be enabled Day 1 or toggled after validation. If enabled Day 1 we should pre-provision the larger context instance sizes.
- Marcus: schedule and run the Tuesday 2/16 11:00 PT kickoff; I'll create the calendar invite and a short runbook for the first-week tests.

Attachments included: token_profile_v1.xlsx, model_shortlist_summary.pdf. Related links: HubSpot deal VH-2397, DocuSign placeholder for SOW.

Next steps: calendar invite sent. Please review the workbook and the routing %s above before the kickoff.

Marcus Lin
Implementation Lead — Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
